title: Plans Within Plans
description: At the start of each battle you get Prep equal to your int. When a fight ends, lose all Prep. During a combat you can always mark a Condition to get 1 Prep, and you can spend 1 Prep to execute one of the following stratagems:

bullets: Bait & Switch — When an ally **close** to you would take dmg, exchange positions unimpeded and suffer the dmg yourself
Charge! — You and willing allies rapidly move towards different foes. You, foes, and allies all get **adv** to their next dmg rolls
Flanking Tactic — When an ally **Trades Blows** with an opponent you're engaged with, they get **adv** to their dmg roll
Hammer & Anvil — When you suffer max dmg, an ally gets **adv** to their next **Trade Blows** against that same opponent

title: Attack of Opportunity
description: When you react to an NPC in **hand** reach moving away, roll+int.

bullets: An ally freely moves towards or away from them
You inflict min dmg to them

outcomes.text: The NPC escapes too quickly; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Know Thy Enemy
description: When you're about to **Trade Blows** with an NPC, you can spend 1 Prep to ask GM what they Resist. You can spend 1 additional Prep to produce the tools necessary to ignore one of those Resists.

outcomes.text: When you **go looking for someone from a past battle, friend or foe**, choose one from the following list—or two if you owe them or put them at risk (your call):
bullets: They're willing to assist you with a current conflict
They offer guidance, advice, or safety for some time
They reveal a significant secret or opportunity

outcomes.text: Add the following stratagems to your **Plans Within Plans**:
bullets: Demoralize — A Bloodied opponent surrenders or flees
First Strike — An ally acts now, even if they're surprised
Ralling Cry — Other allies **near** you clears a Condition
Taunt — An opponent has **dis** to dmg rolls unless they include you as a target
